result:
Confirmed the paths. I've verified against the actual source:

- `src/config/constants.ts` defines `WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5`, but it is never imported or referenced anywhere in `src/` (grep confirms zero usages outside its own definition).
- `src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts` instead defines its own local `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6`, which is what actually gates delivery abandonment (`delivery.attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS`).

Two documents assert that the retry ceiling comes from `WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS` in `constants.ts`, which the code contradicts:

- `docs/db/tables-webhooks-search-and-infra.md` says deliveries stop once they reach "`WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (5, from `src/config/constants.ts`)" — the code never reads that constant for this purpose; the real ceiling is the unrelated local `6`.
- `docs/requirements/webhooks.md` (REQ-157) explicitly states "`MAX_ATTEMPTS` is read from `WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS` in `src/config/constants.ts`, not hardcoded separately in `webhook-delivery-job.ts`" — the opposite of what the code does; it *is* hardcoded separately there, and the constants.ts value (5) is unused/dead.

The scheduler cadence table and `TICK_INTERVAL_MS` (`docs/adr/ADR-016-interval-scheduler.md`, `docs/design/background-jobs.md`) and the session TTL (`docs/requirements/auth-and-sessions.md`, `docs/design/service-auth-and-session.md`, `docs/adr/ADR-020-opaque-session-tokens.md`) all match `scheduler.ts` and `session-service.ts` exactly — no contradiction there. `ADR-005`'s "hourly by default" line is explicitly self-flagged in its own Status section as superseded by ADR-016, so it's not an undisclosed discrepancy.

ANSWER: docs/db/tables-webhooks-search-and-infra.md, docs/requirements/webhooks.md
